name: io.github.letdraw/letdraw
title: LetDraw
description: Create, edit, share and export hand-drawn LetDraw diagrams, from code or a prompt.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by your personal LetDraw API token (ld_live_...). Create it in the LetDraw app under Account > Developer.

environmentVariables.name: LETDRAW_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your personal LetDraw API token (ld_live_...). Create it in the LetDraw app under Account > Developer.

environmentVariables.name: LETDRAW_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the hosted MCP endpoint. Default: https://api.letdraw.com/mcp
